title: TEST CHAMBER 13
pa: The receiving bay accepts careful deliveries.
Throwing is not a delivery method.

addedBoxes.note: Plate-bay roof; underside y = 2.4 allows a generous carry clearance through the open south face while preventing an overhead drop.
West bay wall; carry around its south end before approaching the plate.
East bay wall; the interior is 3.8 m wide.
North bay wall closes the back; the south entrance at z = -0.8 stays open.
Staff landing at y = 3.6; underside y = 3.2 leaves the lower east door clear. Continue to z = 5 at the existing upper exit.
Privacy screen conceals the southern staircase. Its entrance is around the west end at x = 2.3.
Fix: staff bridge north to the shell catwalk at the real staff hatch (z -4.5); the high route otherwise dead-ends at the wall above the door.

solution: Possess the arm and press the button at (-6.7, 1.3, 0.8), releasing the crate and opening the staff hatch.
Possess the drone, fly to (8.5, 5.2, -6), and zap the panel at (8.5, 6.7, -7.5) to set override.

Possess the arm and carry the released crate at centre height y = 1.1 from (-5.6, -1.6) through these (x, z) waypoints: (1.4, -1.6), (1.4, 0.6), (4.8, 0.6), then (4.8, -2.8). This 16 m carry goes around the west wall and north through the bay's open south face. Set the crate down on the plate below y = 1.2; do not throw it.
With override set and the crate on the plate, possess the base and walk across the floor to the east door at z = 5.

Hidden: after the same button, override and crate sequence, take the base around the screen's west end to x = 2, z = 7.1 on the floor. Jump east along the six 1.4 m treads, gaining only 0.6 m each time. From the y = 3.6 landing, walk north to z = 5 and east through the opened staff hatch above y = 3.
